candidateOccurrences.sourceText: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.
